method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Nvidia board meeting to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s fate stretches into evening
Equities.summary: Nvidia's board is meeting days after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.
Equities.reason: High-impact governance and national-security shock at the market's largest AI leader. This raises uncertainty about leadership, regulatory scrutiny and China export controls — a negative catalyst for the AI/tech-led market regime and Nasdaq exposure.

Equities.title: Asian stocks fragile, Nvidia plummets as board to decide CEO's fate
Equities.reason: Regional market reaction shows spillover from the Nvidia governance story into broader Asian equities — underscores risk-off dynamics in tech-heavy indices and fragile market breadth.

Equities.title: Nvidia Troubles Drag Stocks Lower, Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market-wrap framing the Nvidia scandal as a primary headwind for US equity moves today — signals that a major single-stock shock is driving intraday risk sentiment and weighing on market internals.

Equities.title: CoreWeave soars more than 24% for best day since April 2025 after strong Q3 report
Equities.summary: Neoclouds such as CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN have come under scrutiny this month as investors assessed the sustainability of the AI trade.
Equities.reason: Earnings-driven relief in AI infrastructure names is supporting the broader AI-led market narrative and drawing buyers back into tech, partially offsetting the Nvidia-led shock.

Equities.title: AI stocks rebound and carry the NASDAQ 100 to a one-week high
Equities.summary: The more artificial intelligence (AI) a US index holds, the more of the fall that began on November 5 it has now recovered. The NASDAQ 100 touched just under 28,600, above where it started that session, and is trading near 28,400.
Equities.reason: Market internals show buyers stepping back into AI-heavy indices — a counterbalance to headline risk that supports continued leadership of AI names despite idiosyncratic shocks.

Equities.title: Investors Run Back to AI Stocks, Less Than a Week After a Historic Selloff
Equities.reason: Shows investor rotation and risk appetite returning to core AI exposures; reinforces the dominant market regime where AI leadership remains the primary thematic driver even after sharp bouts of volatility.

Equities.title: MSCI to drop Strategy from global indexes, putting billions in passive fund inflows at risk
Equities.reason: Index reweighting/removal has implications for passive flows and sector/strategy positioning — a modest negative for stocks dependent on index-driven inflows and for liquidity in affected ETFs.

Equities.title: MSCI adds four Indian stocks to key global index as part of November review
Equities.reason: Index inclusion likely to draw incremental foreign passive flows into Indian equities — a small positive for EM flows and regional equity demand amid global rotation.

Rates.title: Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: Actual policy tightening by the BoE is a clear negative for bond prices (pressure on yields higher). High relevance given it is a rate decision and alters the UK yield trajectory.

Rates.title: BoE’s Greene says it is appropriate to proactively tighten our monetary policy stance
Rates.summary: Bank of England's (BoE) Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) member, Megan Greene, said on Wednesday that it was appropriate to "proactively tighten ‌our monetary policy stance" to ward against the risk of wage growth getting stuck at higher levels and firms passin
Rates.reason: A policymaker signalling proactive tightening increases odds of further hikes — negative for bonds. Medium-high relevance as guidance to future rate path.

Rates.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
Rates.reason: Hoter-than-expected CPI increases Fed rate-hike risk / 'higher-for-longer' pricing — negative for bond prices (yields up). High relevance as a major data print.

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker suggests slightly higher wage growth in first three quarters of 2027 compared with the full year of 2026
Rates.reason: Upward wage momentum implies stickier inflation in the eurozone and pressure on yields — modestly negative for bond prices. Relevant for medium-term ECB path.

Rates.title: Long US Bonds Reopen With Gains as Risk Sentiment Sours Again
Rates.reason: Report of long‑bond gains signals a bond rally / lower yields (safe‑haven flows). Market‑level price action is directly positive for bonds with meaningful relevance.

Rates.title: Indonesia Bonds Lure Global Funds as Yields Hit Six-Year High
Rates.reason: Yields at multi‑year highs indicate tightening/repricing in Indonesian bond market — negative for bond prices; also draws global flows but reflects higher local yields.

Rates.title: Japan 5-Year Bond Sale Sees Firm Demand as Yields Entice Buyers
Rates.reason: Firm auction demand suggests investor appetite at current yields — supportive for JGB prices (yields may ease). Relevant as primary-market evidence on demand/yield dynamics.

Rates.title: New Zealand Bond Auction Demand Climbs to Highest Since 2013
Rates.reason: Strong auction demand points to bond buying interest and potential downward pressure on local yields — directly relevant to NZ rates and regional flows.

Rates.title: BoJ's Asada says must be mindful of expected effect of past rate increases on economy
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Toichiro Asada said on Thursday that the central bank must be mindful of expected effect of past rate increases on economy. Asada added that underlying inflation fluctuates around levels consistent with BoJ's price target.
Rates.reason: Policymaker noting the lagged effects of prior hikes signals caution on further tightening — modestly positive for bonds (lower hike odds). Relevant as BoJ policy commentary.

Rates.title: Trading Day: AI cheer banishes rate hike fear
Rates.reason: Market narrative that AI optimism reduces rate‑hike fears implies easing of tightening risk and supports bond prices — relevant to short‑term rates/yield moves.

FX.title: US Dollar Index (DXY) rises above 103.00, highest since April 2025 on Fed bets, Iran risks
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, hits a fresh high since April 2025 during the Asian session on Thursday, with bulls looking to build on the momentum beyond the 103.00 mark.
FX.reason: DXY at multi-year highs is a clear USD-strength signal that drives broad FX flows and dominates the FX narrative (Fed hawkish bets + geopolitical risk). High relevance as a market-regime indicator.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Declines below 1.1100, negative outlook remains intact under 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair declines to near 1.1080 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. A cautious stance from the European Central Bank (ECB) weigh on the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: EUR weakness vs USD consistent with the dominant USD-strength narrative. Article is a price/technical forecast so relevance capped at 0.8 per framework.

FX.title: Australian Dollar declines to near 10-month lows
FX.summary: AUD/USD loses ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.6840 during Asian hours on Thursday. The pair falls to nearly 10-month lows as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from an increasingly hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) policy outlook.
FX.reason: AUD hitting multi-month lows reflects USD outperformance driven by hawkish Fed pricing and policy divergence (RBA vs Fed). Representative of major-currency pressures vs USD.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah hits record lows on MSCI index concerns, political uncertainty
FX.summary: USD/IDR rises after opening at a bullish gap, trading around 18,260 during Asian hours on Thursday. The currency pair climbed to a fresh record high of 18,272 amid renewed concerns over Indonesia’s emerging-market status.
FX.reason: EMFX-specific hit driven by USD strength and index/EM flows (MSCI & political risk). High relevance within FX as an EM stress indicator tied to USD and portfolio flows.

FX.title: Japan’s Mimura says forex fluctuations are too rapid
FX.summary: Japan's top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura said on Thursday that recent currency moves, including those of the past few days, are too rapid.
FX.reason: Official Japanese comments flag intervention risk or policy response that could support JPY. This is a counter-signal to USD strength; relevance kept moderate as a central-government FX signal.

FX.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Weakens below 109.50, bearish outlook prevails under the 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The AUD/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 109.30 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Traders remain on high alert for currency intervention from Japanese authorities to prop up the Japanese Yen (JPY).
FX.reason: Cross highlights JPY support/intervention risk (JPY strength vs AUD). As a price-forecast piece it’s capped at 0.8 relevance but flags a material potential policy response that matters for FX regimes.

FX.title: US Dollar: Supportive fundamentals offset deficit worries – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank’s FX Strategy team argues that reduced fears of political interference at the Federal Reserve and evidence of renewed safe-haven demand support the Dollar. The bank notes that concerns over the US budget deficit and treasury market stresses could weig
FX.reason: Research note explicitly supports the USD on fundamentals and safe-haven demand, reinforcing the broader USD-strength narrative; medium-high relevance for directional FX positioning.

FX.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until leader of the revolution orders
FX.summary: Iranian Armed Forces Deputy Chief of Staff Brigadier General Kioumars Heidari said that Tehran has closed the Strait of Hormuz and will not open it except by the order of the leader of the revolution, Al Jazeera reported on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Major geopolitical shock to global energy and risk sentiment which typically boosts USD safe-haven demand and drains risk-sensitive currencies; high relevance for FX regimes and commodity-linked crosses.

Commodities.title: Gold falls below $4,000 as Fed rate hike bets grow
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) tumbles to near $3,985 during the early Asian session on Thursday. The precious metal extends its downside as persistent inflation forces the US Federal Reserve (Fed) to maintain its tightening policy.
Commodities.reason: Monetary-driven gold sell-off: Fed tightening and stronger real yields are a clear negative for gold prices. This is a high-relevance macro driver for precious metals and is reinforced by multiple other headlines.

Commodities.title: Gold falls to over one-week low on firm dollar, Fed rate hike bets
Commodities.reason: Reinforces the dominant gold narrative (USD strength and Fed hikes weigh on XAU). Lower relevance than primary story because it is a corroborating piece rather than new information.

Commodities.title: WTI declines as US, Iran avoids further escalation amid rising OPEC+ output
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends it losses for the fifth consecutive day, trading around $85.00 per barrel during Asian hours on Thursday.
Commodities.reason: Price pressure from easing geopolitical risk (US/Iran de-escalation) and rising OPEC+ output is a clear bearish supply-side signal for crude. Important market-flow item for energy.

Commodities.title: Oil Steadies After Slump as Iran War Talks Make Little Progress
Commodities.reason: Balancing headline: limited progress in Iran talks keeps some risk premium intact, providing support after recent slumps. Moderately relevant as it tempers a pure bearish supply story.

Commodities.title: Refineries have shifted production away from gasoline to middle distillates
Commodities.summary: Particularly high refinery margins for distillate fuel oil and jet fuel have contributed to shifts in the refinery yields of major products in 2026. Data from our latest Petroleum Supply Monthly—which includes data through August 2026—indicate refinery yields
Commodities.reason: Refinery yield shift away from gasoline toward distillates implies tighter gasoline/RBOB supply and firmer distillate fundamentals; this is a supply-side reallocation relevant to product-specific commodity prices (gasoline, diesel, jet).

Commodities.title: Global refinery inputs fell sharply in the second quarter of 2026 before modest recovery
Commodities.summary: Global crude oil refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), or 6%, following the start of conflict in late February in the Middle East, according to data from Kpler. Throughput then increased by 1.8 million
Commodities.reason: Earlier sharp drop in refinery throughput (conflict-driven) tightened product markets; the subsequent partial recovery tempers the bullishness but the net effect remains supportive for energy prices due to earlier disruption.

Commodities.title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
Commodities.summary: In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly
Commodities.reason: Higher U.S. imports from Venezuela increase available supply to U.S. refiners and act as a modest downward influence on crude price; relevance is limited to regional flows and magnitude is moderate.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Hurricane-driven production shut-ins in the Gulf raise short-term supply disruption risk for crude and natural gas liquids; this is a high-relevance weather shock supporting near-term energy prices.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD flirts with trading range support, holds above $51.00
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) edges lower following the previous day's two-way price swings, retesting the weekly trough around the $51.20-$51.15 area, during the Asian session on Thursday.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece on silver. Per scoring rules, price-forecast/technical articles get capped relevance; here it signals short-term bearish pressure but limited structural implication.

Commodities.title: Chile Copper Giant’s Woes Put Private Capital Taboo in Spotlight
Commodities.reason: Idiosyncratic but relevant copper-sector piece: troubles at a major Chilean copper company raise concerns about investment and supply-side stress in copper markets. Moderately negative for copper prices given potential for reduced investment or operations disruption.

Crypto.title: Live news: Bitcoin falls to nearly three-month low after disappointing inflation data
Crypto.reason: Macro-driven selloff: disappointing U.S. inflation data pushed traders to price a higher-for-longer Fed path, triggering correlated pressure on risk assets including BTC and gold. This is a market-regime negative for crypto (rate-sensitivity and risk-off).

Crypto.title: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
Crypto.reason: Flow-driven headwind: continued crypto ETF outflows indicate persistent liquidity pressure and investor de-risking from BTC despite a broader stock rebound; reinforces negative sentiment for Bitcoin.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
Crypto.reason: Security/tech risk: a protocol bug affecting node trust on Tor raises short-term confidence and operational risk for BTC infrastructure; negative for sentiment but limited to technical vector.

Crypto.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
Crypto.reason: Adoption/utility positive: progress toward a bank-lending product onchain represents mainstreaming and real-world utility for the XRP Ledger, supportive for XRP and tokenized finance narratives.

Crypto.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
Crypto.reason: Institutional/legal adoption: a broker-dealer license enabling regulated U.S. assets onchain materially advances tokenization infrastructure and could attract regulated capital — positive for crypto markets' structural demand.

Crypto.title: Nomura Explores Possible Sale of Laser Digital Crypto Unit
Crypto.reason: Institutional pullback signal: a major bank exploring a sale of its crypto unit may signal reduced strategic appetite or consolidation in institutional crypto services, a modest negative for flows and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
Crypto.reason: Regulatory gap risk: analysis that key guarantees exclude DeFi lending highlights a policy/regulatory vulnerability for decentralized credit — negative for DeFi protocols and related tokens.

Crypto.title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
Crypto.reason: Tokenization positive but niche: a very large tokenized fund underscores growing use-cases and capital formation onchain; constructive for long-term adoption but limited near-term market impact.

Crypto.title: The crypto wallet that grew up inside Telegram is striking out on its own
Crypto.reason: Product-level adoption: wallet spinout indicates ecosystem maturation and user-focused product diversification; mildly positive for onchain activity but low market-wide relevance.

Crypto.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
Crypto.reason: Regulatory/legal cooperation: industry alignment with U.S. government in legal disputes can reduce legal uncertainty around certain products and sets precedent; modestly positive for regulatory clarity.
